meta.title: Background (Prior Employment) reskins: 5e background and S7 choices -> modern-Earth display name (names and flavor only)
meta.version_file: tables/background-reskins.version.json (sha256, built_at, entry_count, diff); history in tables/background-reskins.CHANGELOG.md

id_scheme.id: background ids are the lower-cased chargen-5e.json background keys (acolyte ... wayfarer). Choice ids: feat-<origin feat>, asi-2-1, asi-1-1-1, package-a, package-b. Never change once published.
id_scheme.stored_on_sheet: Sheets keep storing the 5e background key, origin feat and package id as today; this table only changes what /create and announcements show.
id_scheme.lookup: Look up by id, or by (kind, chargen_value): chargen_value is the exact string used in chargen-5e.json (background key, origin_feats entry, package id) or the spec string for the ability bonus picks.
id_scheme.fallback: If an id is missing, fall back to srd_name (exact, case-insensitive).

meta.display_rule: Show combined_label = 'Display Name (5e Name)'. Names and flavor only: ability score bonuses, feats, skills, tools, equipment and gold are untouched. Skill and tool names stay plain. label_name, when present, is the short 5e name used in the label because srd_name itself has parentheses (Magic Initiate): labels never nest parentheses.

kinds.background: the 16 backgrounds on S7 (chargen-5e.json backgrounds); chargen_job keeps the earlier placeholder job line from that file
kinds.choice: other labels on S7: parent_id origin-feat (the 12 origin feats in chargen-5e.json origin_feats), background-asi (the +2 / +1 and +1 / +1 / +1 picks), background-kit (starting-gear Package A and Package B, shared by all backgrounds)

meta.tone: DCC dungeon-crawl gallows humor, prior jobs that went badly, modern Earth, petty and funny. Adults-only table, cursing cleared. Crawlers, never the other word. One industry and one punchline per entry.

needs_code.what: bgnames.js packageLabel(t, pkg, gpText, plain) is called from screens.js with gpText built from GP ('{gp} GP left over' for a package with items, '{gp} GP' for the gold option). Switch the S10 background menu to credits so it matches the class menu (package-class-a, package-class-b, package-gold in create-screens-reskins).
examples: Cardboard Carton From Your Desk (Package A) - 8 credits left over
needs_code.units: 1 credit = 1 GP (Core 5.10). The amounts are the chargen-5e.json gp numbers, unchanged. Whole credits print without decimals (15 credits); a fraction prints with decimals (0.5 credit); 1 cp = 0.01 credit. Singular 'credit' for an amount of 1 or less. Starting-package amounts are whole numbers.
needs_code.not_changed_here: The table stores names and flavor only; no amount is stored in this file.

consumers: /create S7 (Prior Employment) and S10 package screens

entries.flavor: Ran Wednesday-night youth group on two pizzas and divine patience. Found out heaven has no petty credits.
Your handmade candle empire grossed 41 dollars, and 40 of it was your mother. The glue gun is still plugged in.
Sold leggings, essential oils and a dream to everyone you ever met. Your upline still posts about your journey.
Talked 400 strangers into reading you their card numbers 'for verification'. Your headset is evidence now.
Played the Cupid Shuffle at nine years of receptions, and the bride's dad still found a reason to be mad.
Fourteen thousand followers, one goat, zero crops. The goat has the better engagement rate.
Defended a ticket machine from nine thousand people with 'no change'. The boom gate is your only friend.

entries.display_name: Trailhead Guide With a Laminated Map
entries.combined_label: Trailhead Guide With a Laminated Map (Guide)
entries.flavor: Led conga lines of tourists up a hill swearing it was 'only ten more minutes'. It was never ten minutes.
Stockpiled four years of canned beans and a bunker for an apocalypse that got canceled for weather.
Ran a million-square-foot warehouse by calling people family and rationing bathroom breaks. HR has a binder with your name on it.
Opened a gallery to show your own paintings with your grandmother's money. Sold exactly one, to your grandmother.
Taught intro rhetoric at four colleges for the combined salary of one decent sandwich. Parking cost more than the pay.
Mopped a buffet line the length of a football field. You can identify a norovirus rumor by sound alone.
Highlighted 'herein' eleven thousand times and billed in six-minute increments. Your wrist has a pension plan.
Stood between a discount toaster and four hundred people. You lost the toaster but kept the vest.
Delivered dinners by day and slept on six couches a month. Your car smells like both, and you know every sofa in three counties.
Hasn't slept through the night since the 2019 inventory audit. Nothing sneaks up on someone who counts ceiling tiles.
Fixes everything with a glue gun and optimism. The repair holds until it is looked at.
Passed a two-hour course on a dummy named Annie. Everybody's choking is now your business.
Never won more than twelve dollars. Somehow always the twelve you needed.
Types 'thoughts and prayers' faster than anybody alive. Surprisingly, some of them land.
Talks to a pothos nine times a day. The pothos has opinions about your landlord.
Started on 'lasagna' and finished on medieval siege engines at 4 AM. Knows one real spell and no lasagna recipe.
Owns the Wednesday slot and a laminated song list. Has been asked to stop, kindly, by four different bartenders.
Survived a Friday rush on a fryer with a mind of its own. When you strike, you strike twice for good measure.
Fixed printers, passwords and one marriage over a screen-share. Have you tried turning it off and on again?
Got into a fistfight over a mailbox color at a public hearing. The minutes are still being disputed.

entries.display_name: Gym Bro Who Spots at Dawn
entries.combined_label: Gym Bro Who Spots at Dawn (Tough)
entries.flavor: Lifts at 5 AM and tells everyone about it. Your hit points are made of protein powder and spite.

entries.display_name: Merit Raise and a Gift Card
entries.combined_label: Merit Raise and a Gift Card (+2 / +1)
entries.flavor: Two points to one stat, one point to another. Management called it recognition.
One point to each of the three stats the job listed. Nobody wins, and everybody gets a little something.

entries.combined_label: Cardboard Carton From Your Desk (Package A)
entries.flavor: Whatever you carried out the front door when they walked you out. It is mostly yours.
Credits in hand, no gear, and a note that says 'good luck'. Shop at the Vending Wall and hope.
